Diehl anunció planes para trasladar la inteligencia de las redes fuera de los centros de datos, impulsando la innovación en la infraestructura de telecomunicaciones.

articles.title: Wikipedians Believed IA Would Come y Go. They Were Wrong
articles.raw_content: In a world of AI Overviews, Wikipedia usage declines. But the real loss may be far more existential than website traffic.
articles.summary: El uso de Wikipedia cae mientras la IA domina, pero la pérdida real va más allá del tráfico web, afectando la relevancia y la supervivencia de la plataforma.

articles.title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "IA first" game development modelo
articles.raw_content:
Epic Games is shifting to an "AI first" development strategy for its collaboration with the Walt Disney Company, letting AI models write all the code and guide all the artwork for an upcoming shooter. That's according to a Bloomberg report, which cites unnamed people familiar with the project who commented on the significant pivot in internal development at the Unreal Engine maker.

Human developers will be tasked with managing and guiding code and art assets generated by models such as Anthropic's Claude, according to internal Epic employee messages viewed by Bloomberg. That means "no more hand-written code" and art assets "generated with full AI workflows," according to the report.

The $1.5 billion collaboration between Epic and Disney, announced in early 2024, was slated to release a Marvel- and Star Wars-themed shooter in March 2027. That project has now been delayed indefinitely amid the AI-related shakeup and understaffed, slower-than-expected development thus far, according to the report.

articles.summary: Epic Games cambia su enfoque a un modelo de desarrollo IA para su colaboración con Disney, dejando que modelos como Claude generen código y arte. Los desarrolladores humanos supervisan y guían los resultados. El proyecto de shooter de Marvel y Star Wars, con una inversión de 1,5 millón de dólares, se retrasa indefinidamente.

articles.title: This IA startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
articles.raw_content: Blueprints AI, a bootstrapped startup based in Santa Monica, developed software that produces code-compliant construction blueprints from a photo, PDF, or sketch.
articles.summary: Blueprints IA, una startup autofinanciada de Santa Monica, ha creado un software que genera planos de construcción compatibles con la normativa a partir de una foto, PDF o boceto en cuestión de minutos, facilitando la obtención de permisos.

articles.title: Microsoft’s nuevo IA chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
articles.raw_content:
Microsoft is announcing its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip today, designed to be the "primary AI inference system" for Microsoft's products and services. Maia 300 not only improves the cost and efficiency of running AI workloads in the cloud, it's also more capable of handling the latest reasoning models and agentic tasks.

Maia 300 will start being rolled out to production in 2027, and it has been designed with efficiency in mind. articles.raw_content: From the newsletter (October 9; sign-up or follow if you want it sooner): Vodafone’s investor day revealed the scale and shape of its enterprise business, from £1.85 billion in annual…
articles.summary: El día de inversores de Vodafone reveló el tamaño y la estructura de su negocio corporativo, con ingresos de £1,85 bn anuales.
